Return structured JSON with a clear 'is_demo' flag when unconfigured
Handle network timeouts gracefully with a 15-second limit

acceptance_criteria: Render skill nodes color-coded by domain category
Highlight connected prerequisite and synergy edges on node selection
Display verified proof items and target role gap in an inspection drawer

challenges.title: Optimize SQL Query for Student Skill Leaderboard
challenges.description: Write an indexed SQL query using Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions (DENSE_RANK) to rank students by verified skill proofs without N+1 queries.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregate verified project proofs and completed challenges per student
Use DENSE_RANK() partitioned by target career track
Add a composite index on (career_id, verified_proof_count DESC)

challenges.title: Containerize React + Flask with Docker Compose
challenges.description: Write a multi-service docker-compose.yml that runs the Flask backend on port 5000 and serves the Vite React frontend with environment variable injection.
acceptance_criteria: Create a lightweight Python 3.12-slim Dockerfile for Flask
Configure healthcheck endpoints for automatic container restart
Pass .env secrets strictly to the backend container only

challenges.title: Architect a Rate-Limited API Gateway Blueprint
challenges.description: Design a token-bucket rate limiter and response cache layer for external career research API calls so 1,000 concurrent students don't exhaust API quotas.
acceptance_criteria: Implement per-student request throttling (10 live lookups/hour)
Cache identical internship role queries for 6 hours
Return clear retry-after headers when quota is exceeded

challenges.title: Implement Graph Shortest-Path Learning Recommender
challenges.description: Use topological sorting and weighted shortest paths (Dijkstra's algorithm) to order a student's learning roadmap from foundational skills to advanced capstone skills.
acceptance_criteria: Represent skill dependencies as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)
Detect cycles and compute minimum learning weeks to target readiness
Output ordered milestone sequence in O(V + E log V) time
